content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text decides D5 vs C5 as underdetermined because CR2 G answers the challenger's almah/bethulah and near-fulfillment rows while the sign's sense remains open, so it is evaluating the collision governed by K-C.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- [CR2] G answers the 'almah/bethulah and near-fulfillment rows, leaving the sign's sense open.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse: one reading permits noting that particular rows were answered while the sign's sense remains open; the other requires comparing the competing chains by footing rather than disposing of the link by row-by-row openness.","why":"The judge uses the open sense left after particular rows are answered to call the link underdetermined, rather than weighing the competing chains against each other by footing as K-C requires."}
